name: Orken
description:
About This Game

THE FINAL DREAM IS UPON US ALL

After his best friend goes missing, the young Khar warrior Coltec must assemble a pack of allies and venture into unknown territory in pursuit of the kidnappers. Along the way, they begin to unravel the terrible fate that will soon befall their homeland, Edom. With his warhammer, Vikari’s Bite, in hand, and the support of his Totem to lend him powerful abilities in combat, Coltec has no choice but to fight for his friend, and his survival. 

GAMEPLAY

Orken is an action-adventure in the vein of Dark Souls and Dragon’s Dogma, blending stunning visuals drawn directly from the artwork of SIXMOREVODKA with tight, stamina-based combat.

Fight the unknown foes using tightly-focused, Soulslike combat, based around the use of special, cooldown-limited abilities to augment basic strikes. Avoid enemy attacks using quick dodges, and manage your stamina-bar, in order to line up your own counterattacks. A poise meter builds up with each hit on an enemy, eventually leaving them staggered and vulnerable, before allowing an execution at low health!

CHOOSE YOUR PATH 

Gain experience through combat and exploration and level-up to unlock new tiers on Coltec's "Atman", a Totem pole representing his soul's attunement to the Spirit World. By rotating each tier, new abilities can activated or deactivated, revealing special combinations when abilities are aligned with each other, amplifying some effects and nullifying others. 

Guide Coltec's journey through dialogue choices and pivotal story moments, directing his fate towards its inevitable conclusion. Characters react to your actions, allowing Coltec to gain and lose favor with others, influencing the options available to you in future moments. Pick your allies carefully, and watch your enemies closely.
short_desc: When his best friend fails to arrive at their secret meeting place, the young Khar warrior Coltec must leave everything behind to discover the terrible fate that has befallen his best friend in this Action-RPG, inspired by Dark Souls and Dragon's Dogma.
